svg.title: Pick what powers the agent
svg.desc: Settings lists what powers your agent: a Claude subscription (Claude Code), a ChatGPT subscription (Codex), an API key, or OpenRouter for any model. You set it once. Holding Send opens a short list of agents to pick another one for that send. It runs on your own subscription or key.
svg.text: Hold Send to pick for one send
Set it once in Settings. It runs on your own subscription or key.
